notes.title: April Playtest Update 1
notes.content:
We have just updated the game, you might have to restart Steam to download it. 

[b]New Features:[/b]
- Gravestones can now be destroyed
- Most food items can now be destroyed
- Ferns can now be destroyed
- Ivy can now be destroyed
- Added server settings for Calling points gain over time and officers being able to spawn on officers

[b]Changes and fixes:[/b]
- Fixed voip randomly breaking
- Wheat and other flora is now easier to destroy
- Branches are now easier to destroy
- Fixed an issue causing players to turn into ghouls
- Fixed an issue making server lagg out when spawning in props while the match is running
- Increased build up zone on Nimy Bridge for defenders
- Fixed basements absorbing bots on Crossroads
- Added a barn to the C capture point on St. Quentin Canal
- Changed brightness and sky and light effects
- Changed fog effect colors slightly
- Updated background music tracks with newer versions
- Increased flamethrower damage slightly
- Increased range of lantern lights
- Made chat hide a little slower
- Fixed shell counter not resetting properly between maps
- Fixed some code to stop spam messages in the player log
- A team can now only have up to 5 sapper spawned lights before they are despawned
- Sapper lights now despawn after a minute of no one using them
- Downed people do no longer count towards damaging sapper spawns
- Fixed a few strings
- Removed friendly fire text on start of map
- You no longer get knocked off when reviving people

notes.title: Playtest Patch 1
notes.content:
We decided to release a small patch fixing some smaller issues and addressing some of the player feedback. Some of the changes might be quite drastic, for example we increased the immune timer to 5 seconds and we increased accuracy of most weapons. As such your feedback on these changes would be very much appreciated. You may need to restart your Steam to download the patch. 

Thank you!

**Changes and fixes:**
- Increased accuracy of Semi-Automatic Rifles by 20%
- Increased accuracy of all Bolt-Action Rifles except the Turkish Mauser by 40%.
- Increased accuracy of the Turkish Mauser by 50%
- Decreased accuracy of the Steyr Machine-Pistol by 20%.
- Increased damage dropoff of the Steyr Machine-Pistol.
- Increased grenade and “small” explosion damage to walls, should make it slightly easier to destroy them now.
- Fixed missing warning icon above Forward Spawns when enemies are nearby. 
- Increased immune time on spawn to 5 seconds from 3. 
- Increased capture speed for both teams and removed the defenders advantage on capturing. 
- Players Officers, like bots, should now automatically declare a charge after the build up timer is over.
- Increased Officer call-in point gain overall and gave attackers a higher multiplier than defenders.
- Fixed a bug causing you to spawn with different grenades than selected in the UI. 
- Players on the attacking team will now get 2 team score instead of 1 per kill. 
- The message for closest player while you are downed will now only show players who are not bleeding out. 
- Chat hotkeys now won't work while in chat. Tab still cycles them.
- Digging no longer gets score multiplied.
- Fixed a bug with class limits on some classes, preventing players from selecting them.
